name: Voice Wake Text
description: When someone in a Discord voice channel says the agent's name, the agent answers in text in that voice channel's chat. For listen-only transcript capture: no realtime voice model. Off until configured.

channelIds.label: Voice channels
channelIds.help: Answer calls in these voice channels (ids). Off until set.

names.label: Names to answer to
names.help: What people call the agent, including likely mishearings, e.g. ["Mina", "Nina"]. Matched anywhere in an utterance, ignoring case, width, spaces and punctuation.

ignoreWords.label: Words that are not a call
ignoreWords.help: Removed before matching, e.g. a common word that contains the name.

ignoreUserIds.label: People who cannot call
ignoreUserIds.help: User ids whose speech never triggers a reply (bots and the agent itself are always ignored).

sessionKey.label: Session
sessionKey.help: Default agent:{agentId}:voice-wake:{channelId}: one session per voice channel.

contextLines.label: Lines before the call
contextLines.help: How many earlier utterances are sent with the call. Default 12.

settleMs.label: Wait for quiet (ms)
settleMs.help: After the name, wait until the room is quiet this long, so the rest of the request is included. Default 3000.

cooldownMs.label: Minimum gap (ms)
cooldownMs.help: Between two answers in one room; calls in between are answered once afterwards. Default 10000.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.help: What the agent is sent. {lines} = the conversation, {silent} = silentReply.

postTranscript.label: Also post the transcript
postTranscript.help: Post every utterance in the voice channel's chat as well (who said what). Off by default.

sessionHeader.label: Join notice
sessionHeader.help: Posted in the voice channel's chat when the agent joins the room to listen (a capture starts). {name} = the first of names. Off by default.

sessionFooter.label: Leave notice
sessionFooter.help: Posted when the agent leaves (the capture stops), after the last transcript lines. Off by default.
